title: Infrared forecast & decision settings
description: What the roadmap, financial forecast and the CTO's preferences are turned into. Written by hand at first; an LLM may later fill it from roadmap text, but the engine only ever sees this JSON. Everything the scoring needs to be deterministic is explicit here: scenario weights, constraint thresholds and the cost/risk/effort weights.

horizon_months.description: Planning horizon used for total cost and payback.

scenarios.description: Growth scenarios. Monthly multipliers compound: month n load = today x multiplier^n (1.00 = flat, 1.03 = +3%/month).

events.description: Optional one-off roadmap steps (launch, new region, campaign) applied on top of every scenario.

hard_constraints.description: A candidate violating any of these is dropped (and the reason recorded). Evaluated on the end state of each candidate, including 'do_nothing'; if the current estate already violates one, do_nothing is reported as infeasible but still shown as the baseline.

allowed_regions.description: Region ids, or prefixes ending in '*' (eu-*).

applies_to.description: Data classifications the rule covers. 'unknown' covers anything the extractor could not classify.

max_monthly_run_cost_eur.description: Applies to the base scenario at the end of the horizon.

min_availability_pct.description: Combined availability of the critical path.

security_gates.description: Booleans over the end state. true = enforce.

require_backups.description: Stateful components with data need backup_retention_days > 0.

ha_level.description: Target availability posture for production stacks.

weights.description: Used to rank candidates on the Pareto frontier: score = w_cost*norm(total_cost) + w_risk*norm(risk) + w_effort*norm(migration_effort); lower is better; normalisation is min-max across surviving candidates; weights are re-normalised to sum 1. Explicit numbers make the winner deterministic.

strategies_enabled.description: Which candidate generators the engine may use. do_nothing must always be present.

downtime_cost_per_hour_eur.description: Revenue/penalty lost per hour of full outage of the critical path. Expected outage loss = (1 - availability) x 8760 h x this.

downtime_cost_by_stack.description: Optional overrides keyed by stack id (e.g. dev = 0).

engineer_hourly_eur.description: Loaded cost used for migration effort and operations hours.

probability.description: Scenario weights across low/base/high must sum to 1 (checked by check_mock.py, not expressible in JSON Schema).
